coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable categories (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), the broad comparison of pretrained/baseline models with feedback-trained models, and structural diversity including long carbon chains.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration. Substitutes GSK3β, JNK3, and Mpro for ESR1 and ACAA1, and does not compare synthetic versus natural-product domains. Reports docking summaries rather than top-three property scores and omits the specified binding-affinity improvements. Introduces unrelated RL and agentic experimental conditions.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected findings: MOLGEN's high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% and 70.4% improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained diversity.
